name: FreeU (v1)
plain: Rescales UNet decoder features before they merge with the encoder skip: the first half of the backbone channels gets a flat gain, and the skip's low frequencies are attenuated in FFT space. Used to shift the balance between backbone denoising and skip detail on SD-style UNets.
math:
Only when the output-block channel count C(h) equals mc·4 (uses b1,s1) or mc·2 (b2,s2), mc=model_channels from the unet config.
h[:, :C/2] ← h[:, :C/2]·b
ĥ = fftshift(FFT2(hsp)); ĥ[centre ±1 bin box] ×= s; hsp ← Re(IFFT2(ifftshift(ĥ)))
Fourier threshold is fixed at 1, so a 2×2 centre box. No sigma gating: applies every step.

props.architectures: UNet with model_config.unet_config['model_channels'] (SD1.x/SD2/SDXL-style). Reads that key directly, so a DiT with no model_channels raises KeyError at patch time.
